display.name: LiSN collector — is it working right now
display.description: Four-row ops surface: alive / keeping up / losing anything / source. Thresholds and ceilings match the acceptance-run failures. SigNoz Cloud / community schemaVersion v6 (Perses).

display.name: lisn.workers.live (red if < 5)
display.description: Heartbeating workers. THE metric for 27/29 Aug four-day silence. Expect ~5 with all workers up.

display.name: worker heartbeat age (max, seconds)
display.description: Stalling worker before death. WARNING alert at > 60s. Uses lisn.worker.heartbeat_age.max (OTel histogram export), not the bare histogram name.

display.name: seconds since last completed page (per source)
lisn.source.calls /s (ceiling 3 for sentinel)
display.description: Agreed enrichment ceiling is 3.0 req/s (3 tasks x 1/s). Discovery is slower — do not use the same ceiling.

display.name: lisn.page.duration p50 / p95 by stage
display.description: Histogram percentiles — query lisn.page.duration.bucket (SigNoz splits OTel histograms).

display.name: lisn.reconcile.unloaded (must stay 0)
display.description: Raw without load — silent failure. CRITICAL if >0 for 15m.

display.name: lisn.discovery.gaps (must stay 0)
display.description: 104 incidents lost with green health surfaces. CRITICAL if >0.

display.name: lisn.jobs.dead_lettered rate
display.description: Empty when no pages were dead-lettered in the window — expected in healthy ops.

display.name: shortfall pages (returned < requested)
display.description: Counter rate + stock gauge. Anomaly, not always error.

display.name: lisn.source.latency p50 / p95
display.description: Real answer to how fast Sentinel is (mock to real). Uses lisn.source.latency.bucket for histogram percentiles.

display.name: lisn.source.calls by HTTP status
display.description: Group by http.status_code — matches OTel attribute from collector/metrics.py.

display.name: retry rate (pages.completed status=failed)
display.description: Failed attempts before dead-letter. Correlates with WARNING retries in logs. Empty when every page succeeded — expected after clean collects.

display.title: Row 4 — What is the source doing
